issue: the phase-1 EDD rule strategy under state delay still reaches the goal in 4/5 seeds (seed 5 exhausts the step budget after 37 rejected assignments)
impact: strategy behaviour kept as the baseline; the task planners (task-rule / task-symbolic) reach the goal 5/5 without rejections

issue: the labelled LLM stand-in (llm-stub) never completes the state-delay scenario
impact: with no_progress_limit it ends as FAILED/NO_PROGRESS instead of burning the budget; stub results stay labelled LLM_STUB

issue: effect differences whose plan was made on an older revision (another actor moved first) produce no revision suggestion or regression case
impact: by design (decision D-022): such a difference says the plan was stale, not that the model is wrong; the difference itself stays in the trace

issue: real-model runs depend on the configured relay; some models answer 'upstream service temporarily unavailable'
impact: the conditional model-real check records NOT_RUN or FAIL with the reason; default model gpt-5.6-sol answered in the recorded evidence
reproduce: uv run --frozen python scripts/model_evidence.py (needs FAL_LLM_API_KEY in .env)

issue: the Colima VM disks are sparse files on the Mac: on 2026-09-28 a full host disk aborted the Docker-disk journal (lost image layers, repaired with e2fsck; PostgreSQL recovered cleanly, pg_amcheck clean)
impact: development environment only; heavy scripts now refuse to start without headroom (scripts/disk_guard.py) and return freed blocks with fstrim

issue: when the host has an HTTP proxy, Lima copies it into the VM's /etc/environment without NO_PROXY: calls to 127.0.0.1 then go to the host's proxy, which reaches them only through Colima's port forwarding (502 / connect timeouts right after a service starts, 502 instead of 'connection refused' after it stops)
impact: fixed in the platform's own clients (SDK, order-service adapter, probe and lifecycle bypass proxies for loopback); scripts/in-vm.sh, the Makefile and the test harnesses add loopback to NO_PROXY; make doctor warns when it is missing
reproduce: env -u NO_PROXY -u no_proxy curl -v http://127.0.0.1:<port>/health inside the VM with HTTP_PROXY set

issue: Temporal dev server (Compose) and the order service keep their state in single-node SQLite files
impact: fine for local profiles; not a production configuration

issue: Vite dev server inside the VM needs polling to see host-side edits (virtiofs)
reproduce: edit web/src on macOS while make dev-up runs
